C1013.title: Qingyuan Man Detained After Using 23 Computers with Game Bots to Farm Gold Coins, Earning Over 200,000 Yuan
C1013.summary: In November 2016, police in Lianzhou, Guangdong, cracked a cybercrime case involving a suspect surnamed Liu who operated 23 computers at home running game modification software. By altering the normal operation of online games to farm in-game gold coins, he illegally earned over 200,000 yuan. One suspect was arrested and 23 computers were seized.
